skill_name: Explain the main concept and purpose of the open-source software package "Keras”?
workflow: Keras is an open-source software library designed for deep learning, which is the process of training computers to make decisions based on data. It was built with a focus on being user-friendly and accessible to developers around the world, and it is written in Python. Keras allows developers to quickly and easily design, train and evaluate neural network models, which can be used to solve complex problems.
